name: Vaziri Law LLP

offices.label: Vaziri Law LLP
offices.address: 1901 Ave of the Stars 20th Floor, Los Angeles, CA 90067, USA

about: Vaziri Law LLP is a personal injury firm with a single office in Los Angeles.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; it will visit clients in hospital or at home.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search
G1.evidence: 9 of 12 named attorneys hold an active California licence and none carries an adverse status. 3 name(s) could not be told apart from namesakes and are counted neither way

G2.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search
G2.evidence: No named attorney carries a disbarment, a suspension or a disciplinary resignation on the State Bar of California's record, across the 9 we identified. Administrative suspensions, which the State Bar states are non-disciplinary, are not counted here

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. California publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 11 named attorneys published, and 1 more person in roles the firm states are not a lawyer's.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 299 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2007-01-16, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

fee_statement: Vaziri Law LLP costs you nothing upfront.

logo.source: The icon the firm's own site declares, copied here rather than hot-linked

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

bar_associations.name: American Board of Trial Advocates
bar_associations.quote: graduating law school, he was selected for the prestigious American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA) Fellowship Program, where he rotated through leadin

score.verdict: 4 of 5 eligibility gates passed. 1 could not be answered from the available records (G3) and does not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar D (11/25).

subs.label: Local presence
